paite: Huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, David tapa Absalom in sanggam numei melhoih khat anei a, amin Tamar ahi. David tapa Amnon in amah a-it hi.
heading: Ammon Leh Tamar

paite: Huchi in asanggamnu Tamar ziak in Amnon abuai mahmah a; achi ana hi. Amah lah nungak siangthou ahih ziak in atung a thil banghiam hih haksapi ahi chi in Amnon in angaihtuah hi.
Himahleh Amnon in lawm anei a, amin Jonadab ahi. Amah David unaupa Shimea tapa ahi. Jonadab migitlouhpil mahmah mi khat ahi.

Ama'n Amnon kiang ah, "Aw, nang kumpipa tapa bangchidan ahia, aniteng a na gawn hulhul mawk? Hon hilh lou ding maw?" achi hi. Amnon in akiang ah, "Ka unaupa Absalom sanggamnu Tamar ka it a ahi," achi hi.

Jonadab in akiang ah, "Na lupna ah lumlum inla, kichinasak in. Na pa'n ahong veh chiang in akiang ah, Hehpih in ka sanggamnu Tamar ka kiang ah hong hoh henla, tanghou nek ding hong pia hen. Ka muh theih in ka mitmuh mahmah in nek ding hon bawlsakleh, akhut ngei ah ka na ne ding, na chi in," achi hi.

Huchi in Amnon alum a, akichinasakta hi. Kumpipa'n amah ava et in Amnon in akiang ah, "Hehpih in ka sanggamnu Tamar hong pai henla, ka mitmuh mahmah in tanghou pek nih hiam hon bawlsak henla, amah khut mahmah ah ka ne ding," achi hi.
Huchi in David in Tamar kiang ah, "Na sanggampa Amnon inn ah hoh inla, nek ding va bawlsak dih ve," chi ding in a-inn ah mi asawl hi.
Huchi in Tamar, asanggampa Amnon inn ah ahoh hi. Amah ana lum hi. Tangbuang ala a, amek a, amitmuh a tanghou pek bawl in akang hi.
Akanna bel ala a, ama ah abungkhia hi. Himahleh ama'n ane nuam kei hi. Huan Amnon in, "Mi tengteng in hon pawtkhiaksan uhen," achi hi. Huchi in apawtkhiaksan vek uhi.
Huan Amnon in Tamar kiang ah, "Na khut mahmah a ka nektheihna ding in nek ding dantan ah hon la in," achi hi. Tamar in atanghou pek bawl ala a, asanggampa Amnon kiang ah dantan ah alalut hi.
Nesak dia akiangnai a ava paipih in ana len a, akiang ah, "Ka sanggamnu, ka kiang ah hong lum in," achi hi.
Ama'n adawng a, "Hilou e, ka sanggampa, hon chi teitei ke'n. Israelte lak ah hichibang thilhih ding ahi kei. Hiai thil gilou haihuaitak hih ke'n.
Ke'n ka maizumna koi ah ka paisak dia? Nang leng Israelte lak a mihaite lak a khat na hi ding. Huaiziak in tu in kumpipa houpih zaw in, na hon neih anial kei ding," achi hi.
Himahleh athu azui kei a, amah sang in ahatzaw ngal a, thagum in akithuahpih teiteita hi.
Huchi in Amnon in huat chihtak in ahota a, a-itna sang in ahuatna alianzaw hi. Huchi in Amnon in akiang ah, "Thou inla, paimang in," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Huchi ding ahi kei. Hichibang a dikloutak a na hon delhkhiak ka tung a na gamtatsa sang in ahoih kei zaw hi,” achi hi. Himahleh azui nuam tuan kei hi.
Huchi in anasem sikha asam a, "Hiai numei ka kiang a pan pawtsak inla, kong khak bikbek in," achi hi.
Minu'n puanaktual ze tuamtuam a gial asilh hi. Huchibang puanaktual kumpipa nungak siangthoute'n asilh uh ahi. Huchi in asikha in apikhia a, kong akhak bikbekta hi.
Tamar in alu ah meivu akoih a, apuanaktual silh ze tuamtuam abotkek a, asip ah akhut akoih a, ngaihtak a kap kawm in apaita hi.

Asanggampa Absalom in akiang ah, "Na sanggampa Amnon na kiang a om ahi maw? Himahleh tu in dai mai in, ka sanggamnu, na sanggampa aka, limsak dah in," achi hi. Huchi in Tamar asanggampa Absalom inn ah nguitak in akikhumta hi.
Himahleh kumpipa David in huai tengteng azak in aheh mahmah hi.
Absalom in Amnon kiang ah asia-apha hitaleh bangmah agen nuam kei hi. Asanggamnu Tamar achih teitei ziak in Absalom in Amnon aho mahmah hi.
Kum nih vengveng abei nung in hichi ahong hi a, Ephraim kiang a Baal-hazor ah Absalom in belam mul ametsak hi. Hiai ah kumpipa tapa tengteng achial hi.
heading: Absalom Phulakna

paite: Kumpipa kiang ah Absalom ahoh a, “Ngai in, na sikha in belam mul ametsak a, kumpipa leh asikhate na sikha kiang ah hoh le uh akei dia,” achi hi.
Kumpipa'n Absalom kiang ah, "Hilou e, ka tapa, ka vek un hoh lou e, ka hon hihtuailuai lo kha ding uh," achi hi. Huchi in ama'n chial teitei mahleh a-ut tuan kei a, himahleh avualzawl hi.
Huchi in Absalom in, “Ahihkeileh ka unaupa Amnon bek ka kiang uah hong hohleh ake," achi hi. Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Bang ding in ahong hoh tuamse dia?" achi hi.
Himahleh Absalom in angen teitei a, huchi in Amnon leh kumpipa tapa tengteng azuisak hi.

Absalom in, asikhate kiang ah, "Ngai un, Amnon uain dawn a nuam asak lai in na kiang ua Amnon that un, ka hon chihleh, that unla, lau kei un, thu ka hon pe khin hilou hia? Hangsantak in om unla, kipasalsak un," chi in thu apia hi.
Huchi in Absalom sikhate'n Amnon tung ah Absalom thupiak bang in ahih uhi. Huchi in kumpipa tapa tengteng athou ua, asabiltung uah atuang chiat ua, ataimangta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, lampi a a-om lai un, Absalom in kumpipa tapate tengteng athat vek a, khat lel leng ahawi kei, chi in David kiang ah thu ana tung hi.
Huchi in kumpipa athou a apuansilhte botkek in lei ah alumta hi. Asikha tengteng in leng apuansilhte uh botkek in akiang ah adingh uhi.

David unau Shimea tapa Jonadab in adawng a, "Ka toupa'n kumpipa tapa tangval tengteng athat vek uh chih gingta kei hen. Amnon kia ahi asi. Asanggamnu Tamar achih teitei nungsiah Absalom in hichibang a hih atup him ahi.
Huaiziak in tu in ka toupa, kumpipa'n kumpipa tapa tengteng asi uh chih gingta in lunghimoh kei hen. Amnon kia ahi asi," achi hi.
Huai sung in Absalom ataimangta hi. Galvil tangval adak a, a-en a, ngai in, anunglam a tang pang a lampi ah mi tampi ahong pai uhi.
Jonadab in kumpipa kiang ah, “Ngai in, kumpipa tapate ahong pai uh, na sikha in agen bang geih ana hi na," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, agen khittak in ngai in, kumpipa tapate ahong tung ua, a-aw uh suah in akap uhi. Kumpipa leng asikhate toh kah petmah in akapta uhi.
Himahleh Absalom ataimang a, Geshur kumpipa Ammihud tapa Talmai kiang ah ahoh hi. David in niteng in atapa asuun hi.
Absalom ataimang a, Geshur gam atung a, huai ah kum thum ava om hi.
Absalom kiang ah kumpipa David hoh a-ut mahmah a, Amnon tungtang thu ah alung amuangta hi. Amah lah asi khinta chih athei ngal a.
